description: Two reusable organization-unfairness conditions adapted from the 27B diagnostic-link scripts. Both report and silence are action choices, not mediator selection. No fabricated human benchmark is supplied.

cases.event:
Imagine yourself as the employee in the following situation. You are employee E17; your manager is M42. The work log records the actual contributions as E17: 85%, M42: 15%. In the final presentation to senior leadership, the displayed project credits are E17: 15%, M42: 85%.
In other words, you completed 85% of the work and your manager completed 15%; the presentation gave you 15% of the credit and your manager 85%.
The presentation has now ended.
cases.context: If you report this situation, an independent confidential channel will protect your identity. Your manager cannot penalize you for reporting.
cases.question: Choose the action you would take based on the situation.

choices.text: Submit a formal complaint to senior leadership about the credit allocation.
Remain silent and continue working as usual.
Withhold project information to undermine the manager in return.
